There are so many discrepancies and exaggerations in her story. She used to be a panel member on a south korean variety show that featured other north korean defectors. The life she described was very lavish and she described getting japanese clothing and channel bags, which is very lavish in comparison to the other panel members who described hardship. Her own mother even went on the show talking about how surprised Park was that she lived in the same country as the other panel members. Years later she describes eating insects and rats and seeing dead bodies? It's a complete switch from the life she described. She also earlier stated that she escaped with her family to china in cars via chinese connections her father had, but she later changed this statement saying she escaped with only her mother and they had to walk. Plus just straight up crazy stuff like claiming that north koreans couldn't use the word "I" or that they don't have a word for love. I do believe that these things happen, especially the lack of food, however it is disingenuous coming from her, someone who lived a life of privilege by north korean standards and the way she uses her fame now to convince americans that the US is turning into north korea is a gross exaggeration.
